title: UAAP: NUNS girls make quick work of UPIS for win no. 4

blocks.text: National University-Nazareth School stretched its unbeaten run to four games in the UAAP Season 89 girls' volleyball tournament, sweeping the University of the Philippines Integrated School, 25-13, 25-8, 25-15, on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym in Loyola Heights, Quezon City.
